content.title: Directional Strokes | Action Switches Roles and Builds a Final Mark
content.summary: Let the first character's movement generate a strong directional stroke that becomes a compositional divider on landing. Bring a second character in along the same graphic axis, bend the stroke into new geometry, and complete one wordless final mark through both actions.

quick_start.input_format: The first action generates directional strokes + landing changes separation + the second character enters along the same axis + stroke deformation + no text final state mark
quick_start.recommended_input: The blue papercraft automaton turns the carbon black ruler into a compositional divider. The amber automaton enters along the same axis and bends the ruler into a spiral. The two movements together form a wordless turbine mark.
required_anchors: Bind the first action to one dominant directional stroke.
Use the first landing to change the stroke's composition role.
Let the second action bend or reconfigure the stroke.
Hold one final mark that visibly inherits both actions.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Let the first character's movement generate a strong directional stroke that becomes a compositional divider on landing. Bring a second character in along the same graphic axis, bend the stroke into new geometry, and complete one wordless final mark through both actions.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Let one performer action generate or align with a strong directional stroke, use the landing to convert that stroke into a composition divider, switch to a second performer on the same graphic axis, let the second action bend the stroke into a new geometry, then hold the completed abstract mark as the consequence of both actions.

invariants.rule: Bind the first action to one dominant directional stroke.
invariants.ablation_failure: A decorative line adds no causal role.

invariants.rule: Use the first landing to change the stroke's composition role.
invariants.purpose: Creates a visible handoff from action to layout.
invariants.ablation_failure: A normal landing leaves no graphic consequence.

invariants.rule: Introduce a second performer on the established graphic axis.
invariants.purpose: Links role switch to the same system.
invariants.ablation_failure: A new unrelated frame breaks continuity.

invariants.rule: Let the second action bend or reconfigure the stroke.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unchanged divider makes the second role redundant.

invariants.rule: Hold one final mark that visibly inherits both actions.
invariants.ablation_failure: A random title card cannot prove the two-action construction.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: source graffiti rail, bar swing and number eight
source color blocking and final mark
